_note: Single source for the product line. scripts/build_packaging.py renders packs, the brand book product pages and docs/product/product-line.md from this file. Formulas and percentages are indicative placeholders until the formulator and lab confirm them.

name: Daily Lotion
products.line: Oat and shea butter, for skin that stays soft till bedtime.
products.use: Smooth onto clean skin after the bath and whenever skin feels dry.
products.inci: Aqua, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Cetearyl Alcohol, Glyceryl Stearate, Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Sodium Stearoyl Glutamate, Xanthan Gum, Tocopherol, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate, Citric Acid.

name: Massage Oil
products.line: Cold-pressed coconut and almond oil for the daily maalish.
products.use: Warm a few drops between your palms. Massage in long, gentle strokes before the bath.
products.inci: Cocos Nucifera (Coconut) Oil, Prunus Amygdalus Dulcis (Sweet Almond) Oil, Sesamum Indicum (Sesame) Seed Oil, Withania Somnifera (Ashwagandha) Root Extract, Tocopherol.
products.caution: Contains almond oil. Do not use if your baby has a nut allergy.

name: Rich Cream
products.line: Shea, oat and ceramides for dry patches and winter cheeks.
products.use: Apply a little to dry patches, cheeks and elbows, two or three times a day.
products.inci: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Flour, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Ceramide EOP, Phytosphingosine, Cholesterol, Squalane, Sodium Lauroyl Lactylate, Carbomer, Xanthan Gum, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.

name: Diaper Rash
Cream
products.line: Zinc oxide and calendula form a breathable barrier at every change.
products.use: Clean and dry the nappy area. Apply a thin layer at every change.
products.inci: Zinc Oxide (15%), Ricinus Communis (Castor) Seed Oil, Cera Alba (Beeswax), Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Butyrospermum Parkii (Shea) Butter, Lanolin, Tocopherol.

name: All-Purpose
Balm
products.line: Ghee, beeswax and kokum butter for chapped cheeks, lips, knees and cuticles.
products.use: Warm a little on your fingertip and press onto rough or chapped skin.
products.inci: Ghee (Clarified Butter), Cera Alba (Beeswax), Garcinia Indica (Kokum) Seed Butter, Calendula Officinalis Flower Extract, Tocopherol.

name: Mineral
Sunscreen
products.line: Zinc oxide sits on the skin and reflects the sun. Broad spectrum.
products.use: For babies 6 months and older. Apply generously 15 minutes before going out. Reapply every 2 hours and after water play.
products.inci: Aqua, Zinc Oxide (non-nano, 20%), Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Helianthus Annuus (Sunflower) Seed Oil, Polyglyceryl-4 Isostearate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Magnesium Sulfate, Tocopherol, Sodium Benzoate.
products.caution: Keep babies under 6 months out of direct sun instead of using sunscreen.

name: Talc-Free
Powder
products.line: Corn starch and neem keep skin folds dry, with no talc.
products.use: Shake into your palm, away from your baby's face, then pat onto skin folds.
products.inci: Zea Mays (Corn) Starch, Maranta Arundinacea (Arrowroot) Root Powder, Azadirachta Indica (Neem) Leaf Powder, Kaolin, Tocopherol.
products.caution: Keep away from the baby's face. Do not shake directly over the baby.

name: Bottle Wash
products.line: Soapnut and plant enzymes lift milk residue and rinse clean.
products.use: Pump foam onto a brush or sponge. Scrub, then rinse well under running water.
products.inci: Aqua, Sapindus Mukorossi (Soapnut) Fruit Extract, Decyl Glucoside, Coco-Glucoside, Glycerin, Protease, Amylase, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.

name: Water Wipes
products.line: 99% purified water on a plant-fibre cloth. Gentle enough for newborn faces.
products.use: Peel back the lid and pull one wipe. Close the lid firmly to keep the rest moist.
products.inci: Aqua (99%), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.

name: Head-to-Toe
Wash
products.line: One gentle, tear-free wash for hair and body, from the first bath.
products.use: Lather a little in wet hands, wash hair and body, and rinse well.
products.inci: Aqua, Coco-Glucoside, Sodium Cocoyl Glutamate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate, Potassium Sorbate.
products.caution: Tear-free means formulated to be mild on eyes. Rinse with water if any gets in.

name: Tear-Free
Shampoo
products.line: Shikakai and hibiscus for soft, tangle-free hair.
products.use: Massage a coin-sized amount into wet hair, then rinse well, keeping water away from the eyes.
products.inci: Aqua, Decyl Glucoside, Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate, Glycerin, Acacia Concinna (Shikakai) Fruit Extract, Hibiscus Rosa-Sinensis Flower Extract, Hydrolyzed Rice Protein, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.

name: Bubble Bath
products.line: Soft, long-lasting bubbles with rice water and oat.
products.use: Pour one capful under running water. Keep bath time short for very young skin.
products.inci: Aqua, Oryza Sativa (Rice) Water, Coco-Glucoside, Lauryl Glucoside, Glycerin, Avena Sativa (Oat) Kernel Extract, Sodium Chloride, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.
products.caution: For bath use only. Not for babies under 12 months.

name: First
Toothpaste
products.line: Low-dose fluoride and a mild mango taste, for the first teeth.
products.use: Brush twice a day with a smear the size of a grain of rice. An adult should do the brushing. Wipe away the excess; no need to rinse.
products.inci: Sorbitol, Hydrated Silica, Aqua, Glycerin, Xylitol, Cellulose Gum, Decyl Glucoside, Sodium Fluoride (1000 ppm F), Mangifera Indica (Mango) Fruit Flavour (natural).
products.caution: Contains sodium fluoride. Use only a rice-grain amount for children under 3, and supervise brushing. If your child swallows a large amount, see a doctor.

name: Finger
Toothbrush
products.line: A soft silicone brush that slips over your finger to clean gums and first teeth.
products.use: Wash before first use. Slip over your fingertip and gently rub gums and teeth. Rinse and dry after use.
products.contents: 1 finger toothbrush in 100% food-grade silicone, 1 ventilated case.
products.caution: Check before each use and replace at any sign of wear. Always use under adult supervision.

name: Grooming Kit
products.line: A soft brush, comb, nail clipper and file in a washable cotton pouch.
products.use: Trim nails after a bath, when they are soft. File any rough edges. Brush hair gently from the front.
products.contents: 1 soft brush (plant-based bristles), 1 round-tip comb, 1 nail clipper with magnifier, 1 nail file, 1 cotton zip pouch.

name: Taped Diapers
products.line: A cord-cut-out front, soft stretchy tapes and a wetness line that turns blue.
products.use: Open the diaper flat, slide it under your baby and fasten the tapes on the front panel. Fold the front down below the cord stump.
products.contents: Plant-based nonwoven top sheet, fluff pulp, super-absorbent polymer, breathable back sheet, elastic tapes, wetness indicator.

name: Diaper Pants
products.line: Pull-up pants for crawlers and walkers, with a soft all-round waistband.
products.use: Pull up like underwear. To remove, tear the side seams. Roll up and seal with the back tape.
products.contents: Plant-based nonwoven top sheet, fluff pulp, super-absorbent polymer, breathable back sheet, elastic waistband, wetness indicator.

name: Hand & Face Wipes
products.line: A thicker cloth with aloe and cucumber, for meals and sticky hands.
products.use: Wipe hands and face after meals. Close the lid firmly after use.
products.inci: Aqua (98%), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Cucumis Sativus (Cucumber) Fruit Extract, Glycerin, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.

name: Water Wipes
Value Pack
products.line: Three packs of 72 Water Wipes, for the price of two and a half.
products.use: Open one pack at a time. Keep unopened packs out of direct sun.
products.inci: Aqua (99%), Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice, Citric Acid, Sodium Benzoate.
